Name: Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp
Author: Poltergeister
TagLine:
This update combines Lemurkat's NPCs into one mod for East Scarp 3.0 and includes previously unreleased portraits for Victoria and Eyvind.
Gives characters of the East Scarp expansion seasonal outfits and makes them slightly cuter.
Description:
Welcome!

This mod adds seasonal outfits for the characters featured in [East Scarp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787). Add-ons for [Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398) , [Professor Jasper Thomas](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599) and [the last Smoluanu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642) are available. Additionally, this mod edits the overall appearances of the characters as showcased in the picture section. The mod is meant to be used with [Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450)  for a consistent look but it’s not a requirement.
Just like in my other mods, only outfits for Spirit's Eve and Flower Dance are available for festivals. **This means if the characters have outfits for additional festivals natively, my mod will override them with their basic seasonal version.** If you do not want this, turn changes for the character off in the config.
**I will not change or add outfits, portraits or sprites for characters already in the mod!**

Configs

NoNose": "**True**, False"
This decides if the character sprites have noses or not. Set it to "false" if you want the characters to have noses.

"FestivalOutfits": "**True**, False"
Decides if characters will wear Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve outfits.

"CuteX": "**True**, False"
Decides if a character will be affected by the mod or not. Example: Set "CuteAideen" to false if you don't wish to use their cute
version. Neither portrait nor sprite will now be loaded.

"ExtraNPC": "**True**, False"
NPCs in events

I hope you enjoy this mod!
